name: GetSelectedRadioButton
label: Get Selected Radio Button
description: Retrieves the name of the selected radio button in a radio button group or the state of a specific radio button.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element
fields.description: The UI element which you would like to read the selected radio buttons from.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: SelectedRadioButton
fields.label: Selected Radio Button Name
fields.description: Returns the name of the selected radio button, or empty if none is selected.
